title: CSSI S2 authority record
description: One verified authority record per case. Filesystem-wide assertions for content/cases stems and global record_id uniqueness are enforced by LINT-13 because draft-07 validates one JSON instance at a time.

cite.description: Citing-case cite as CL search rows return it: a single cite string, the full parallel-cite array, or null. Adjudicated F-S2-30 2026-07-06: the array form is the honest CL data; controlling_case (point_overrides.by[]) deliberately stays string|null per F-S2-29 semantics.
